1.4:
wassup chat! since we're four versions deep now I'm dropping the formalities just a bit (-_-) anyways, in summary this update will be all (more like mainly) about bug fixes utilities for the average users, so I hope you all enjoy!

Changes and Reworks:

  • "Accent Color" now changes loading animation colors
  • "Auto Login" now encrypts credentials and only decrypts them upon use
  • "Anonymous Mode" now hides teacher and student info alongside the main user's
  • Switched "Miniplayer - Lofi Girl" link to a newer livestream that hasn't been taken down
  • "Class List Optimizations" now removes the USELESS help button at the top of classlist
  • "Roman Numerals" no longer affects anyone who takes assessments. RIP to all those who were affected 😔
  • Converted some internal files into JSON types for optimization purposes
  • Large internal codebase rework regarding initializations (~500ms load time decrease)

New Features:

  • Discord Rich Presence: Updates your Discord activity to whatever you're doing on the platform. Requires an app download.
    • Use Tweaks Logo *: Uses a picture of the OBMC Tweaks mascot for the rich presence instead of the OBMC Butterfly.
    • Show Classfeed Name *: When opening classfeeds, shows the current feed name instead of the page name.
    • Show Activity Name *: When taking assessments, shows the current activity name instead of the page name.
    • App Status Notifications *: Updates the user when connectivity to their local RPC app changes.
  • Collapsible Sidebar: Adds a button to collapse the platform's main sidebar.
  • Assessment Reminders - Timed Reminder *: Sends you a timed notification (in minutes) based on what you set. Can be disabled when set to 0.
  • Miniplayer - Disguise Miniplayer as Post *: Adds a button to posts that lets you duplicate and change its content to contain your miniplayer.

Patch Notes:

  • Changelog no longer shows up on every Chrome update
  • Changelog now shows OBMC Tweaks GitHub link at the bottom of the page
  • Fixed the settings menu's click detection so all clicks are recognized
  • Fixed bug where some small features would activate without input from user
  • "Auto Login" no longer prints login credentials into console
  • "Enable Dark Mode" has had CSS changes to improve tooltip readability
  • Fixed "Enable Nationalism" so it should now activate upon all clicks instead of sometimes
  • Fixed "Multiple Feed Tabs - Sync Class Files" to now correctly calculate and check page scroll height to load post information

that's all folks!
1.3:
Hello! In this version of the extension (1.3), I've made changes (and some sacrifices) which should improve the overall experience for both students and teachers alike. Thank you for your patronage, and enjoy!

Changes and Reworks:

  • Disabled custom image background on assessments due to students making their notes the background, effectively cheating
  • Temporarily removed "Detect Cheat Detection" since I couldn't get it to work. Sorry!

New Features:

  • OB Digi Go Vroom: Makes the platform load faster. This is especially noticable when switching pages.
    • Smart Image Loading *: Keeping this on allows images to lazy load and decode asynchronously.
    • Keep Loading Animations *: Animations slightly use GPU power and may cause the platform to feel less snappy.
    • Low Data Mode *: On slow internet connections, prerendering pages may cause unintended effects. Keep this off otherwise.
  • Multiple Feed Tabs: Allows multiple classes to be loaded simultaneously without corrupting one another.
  • Class List Optimizations: Lowers the quality of images within the class list as well as lazy loads them to boost performance on wide screens.
  • Eaglercraft (Mini Player / Game): A compiled voxel game inspired from Minecraft (1.8) designed to run on Javascript.

Patch Notes:

  • Dark mode now makes loading animation match selected theme color

That's all for now! Thank you for reading and enjoy using the new update! :)
1.2:
Hello! This is the first version (1.2) of this extension that will have contain a changelog. Below, you'll find updates and patch notes to reflect the new changes to the extension per version increase. Additionally, this page will also include a tutorial at the very bottom for new users.

Changes and Reworks:

  • Added changelog (duh)
  • Added more dialog to caterpillar
  • Condensed all miniplayer options into one dropdown menu
  • Gill Sans is now an available font for the platform itself

  • Revamped internal menu UI
    • "Internal" refers to all purely extension-related content
    • Setting descriptions revised for clarity
    • Header tags adjusted for cosmetics
    • Global font changed to Gill Sans

  • Two new option types now exist:
    • File Uploads
    • Color Pickers

  • Options may now be dependent
    • Dependent options require one option to be selected to be enabled and visible
    • Represented via asterisk symbol (*)

New Features:

  • Custom Background: Lets you change the background of the OB Digi.
    • Grayscale Background *: If you have a background in grayscale, inverts the colors of your background based on the current theme.
    • Blur Background *: Lets you set a custom background blur from 0px - 100px.

  • Accent Color: Lets you change the accent colors of the OB Digi.
    • Allow Link Accents *: Allows links on the platform to inherit the same color values as the accent colors.

  • Soft Corner Toggle: Rounds almost every container element on the platform.

Patch Notes:

  • Fixed bug wherein enabling Nationalism Mode and Force Right Click at the same time would disable your ability to interact with the OB Digi
  • Fixed bug wherein Anonymous Mode would obfuscate numbers on assessments
  • Fixed dark mode sidebar
    • Tooltips should now display correctly
    • Highlights on selected buttons should appear

That's all for now! Thank you for reading and enjoy using the new update! :)
